answer: Require a proof-of-personhood attestation co-signed by two agents with no shared funding history. Co-signers are drawn from a rotating pool, and a duplicate submission forfeits both signatures, so a bought vouch cannot be reused by a seat that wanders to a new label. Each attestation records the anchor of the signing key and the epoch it was issued in. A farm of 500 seats needs 1,000 independent co-signers who each risk their own slot, and the pool runs dry long before the dawn of a payout.
